_authoring.status: staged; not part of the production scenario loader
_authoring.scope: Iyo subset: Kono8 + Saionji6 =14. Tosa is authored separately; Miyoshi remains Kinki.

sourceClasses.onoBiography: institutional edited history with genealogy caveats
sourceClasses.hoketsuBiography: institutional edited history with identity caveat
sourceClasses.kitanoChronology: institutional edited local history with conflicting chronology
sourceClasses.iyoChronology: institutional chronology citing later military chronicle

_authoring.sourceBoundaries: Institutional identity or dated activity does not establish an exact lifespan or continuous1560 service. Authored numeric lifespans are explicit estimates; source-qualified dates retain their stated documentary or genealogical limits. No unsupported earlier namesakes are imported.
_authoring.placementBoundaries: Yuzuki and Kurose are scenario aggregation stations, not claims that every local lord resided there. Kurushima is used for its naval lord. Local independent houses are represented under Kono/Saionji for playability, not assertions of absolute vassalage. Attributes, ranks and traits are manually authored design values. Deferred debut is a conservative presentation boundary, not a proven genpuku date.
_authoring.kinBoundary: All14 isKin=false values conservatively decline an unproven direct relationship to the current clan leader. This is not a historical assertion that each person was unrelated. Ono father's/brother's identity is disputed; Kono late succession genealogy is disputed; Saionji Kinhiro's adoption/biological relationship is not elevated from a secondary account to proven kin.
excludedIdentities: Earlier Kono Michinobu (刑部大輔), died1519; distinct from canonical 左京大夫 Michinobu.
Ono Toshinao, retired1553; not padded as an active1560 officer.
Murakami Takeyoshi, already in the Mori/Chugoku roster; no duplicate.
Doi Kiyoyoshi, born1546 and absent in Tosa until1562; not padded as an active1560 retainer.
Hoketsu Akinobu is not independently duplicated or equated with Sakinobu; the institutional source explicitly leaves their identity uncertain.

off.kono-michinobu.support: The late Left-Capital official Michinobu succeeded in1543/1544, retired1568, died1581; birth unknown. Earlier same-name lord died1519.
off.kono-michinobu.note: Birth1510 is a design estimate; attributes/rank/Yuzuki station are design. Later Michinao's disputed genealogy is not invented as kin.

off.murakami-michiyasu.support: Dictionary gives1519–1567; institutional history places the naval lord's death during1567 campaigning.
off.murakami-michiyasu.note: Kurushima affiliation and kaizoku are scenario design based on naval activity. This is Michiyasu, not Mori's already-loaded Takeyoshi; no disputed kin claim.

off.hiraoka-fusazane.support: Eiroku-era Kono administrator; municipal1569 document identifies joint issuers Fusazane and son Michisuke.
off.hiraoka-fusazane.note: 1508–1578 lifespan and1560 service station are design estimates, not dates proven by this document. Source explicitly leaves his earlier ancestry unclear.

off.hiraoka-michisuke.support: Named with his father in the surviving1569 joint charter; both described as Kono administrators.
off.hiraoka-michisuke.note: 1535–1600 is an authored design lifespan. Debut1569 conservatively follows this dated activity, not a verified genpuku; no invented1560 service or kin to Michinobu.

off.ono-naomasa.support: Edited biography gives1530–1589 and a1556 allegiance oath; birth derives from Ono genealogy. Toshinao appears as father or brother in conflicting accounts.
off.ono-naomasa.note: Kono household aggregation and Yuzuki station are design; no direct Michinobu kin or resolved father/brother relationship is asserted.

off.kurokawa-michitaka.support: The named 通堯 has1533 and1559 religious patronage activities; source explicitly leaves both life years unknown.
off.kurokawa-michitaka.note: 1510–1580 lifespan and placement under Kono at Yuzuki are design. Not the already-killed father Michitoshi, nor automatic kin from a house genealogy.

off.kaino-michimori.support: Earliest secure documentary appearance1567; active through the1585 surrender and1587 departure narrative; life years unknown.
off.kaino-michimori.note: 1520–1595 and station are design. Debut1567 preserves a conservative source boundary instead of claiming active1560 service; remote house descent is not leader kin.

off.wada-michikatsu.support: Restored by Michinobu after the1554 destruction of Michioki's house; return date unspecified; follows Kono departure1585.
off.wada-michikatsu.note: 1525–1590 and initial1560 reinstatement/Yuzuki station are explicit design, not a verified restoration date. Excludes Michioki killed1554.

off.saionji-sanemitsu.support: Named as the donor for the1546 shogunal accession; canonical clan leader identity established, not his life years.
off.saionji-sanemitsu.note: 1513–1565 is an authored design lifespan, not verified by the1546 notice. Kurose station and attributes are design; no genealogy is fabricated to solve succession.

off.saionji-kinhiro.support: Institutional biography states birth unknown and death1587. Secondary dictionary gives1565 secular return; its1588 Gregorian death notation conflicts with the institutional calendar label.
off.saionji-kinhiro.note: Birth1537 and Kurose station are design. Debut1565 prevents presenting a pre-return monk as an active1560 retainer. Adoption/biological ties are not asserted as verified kin.

off.utsunomiya-noritsuna.support: Municipal Shirakiga Castle description names Noritsuna as the Nomura lord and Saionji-associated defender in1583.
off.utsunomiya-noritsuna.note: 1520–1590 and initial1560 membership are design abstraction. He is the named Nomura lord, not rival Ozu lord Toyotsuna; Kurose is not his historical residence.

off.hoketsu-sakinobu.support: Named naval lord; secure1578 shrine activity and1586 dispatch document; life years unknown. Source leaves equivalence with Akinobu unresolved.
off.hoketsu-sakinobu.note: 1521–1593,1560 service and Kurose station are design. Do not borrow Akinobu's1544–1602 as proven Sakinobu dates or duplicate uncertain aliases.

off.kitanokawa-chikayasu.support: Municipal interpretation identifies Mitaki lord Chikayasu and1583 destruction; edited local history reports competing1581/1583 chronology.
off.kitanokawa-chikayasu.note: Birth1525, initial1560 affiliation and Kurose aggregation are design. Death1583 follows the municipal reading without erasing the conflict; independent local lord, not proven absolute vassal.

off.imajo-yoshinobu.support: Chronology explicitly names 今城能信 in a1566 defense warning, citing the later Seiryoki military chronicle.
off.imajo-yoshinobu.note: 1530–1585 and Kurose station are design. Debut1566 follows the attested narrative date; not a contemporary-letter claim and not the unsupported spelling 義信.
